name: How long does interior paint typically last before needing to be repainted?

mainEntity.name: How long does interior paint typically last before needing to be repainted?

acceptedAnswer.text: The longevity of interior paint depends on several factors, including the quality of the paint, the preparation of the surfaces, and the amount of wear and tear the area receives. High-traffic areas like hallways and kitchens may need repainting every 3-5 years. Bedrooms and living rooms, which experience less abuse, can often last 7-10 years or even longer. Proper surface preparation and using high-quality paint contribute significantly to durability.
acceptedAnswer.description: Interior paint can last 3-10 years, depending on paint quality, surface prep, and room usage. High-traffic areas require more frequent repainting.
